contentPattern.structure: trail of ancestor links + current page label

suitableFor: navigation showing the current page's location in the site hierarchy

distinctFrom.note: No 'breadcrumbs' or 'breadcrumb' block exists in the local project or the Block Collection library, so this block was built from scratch. It decorates an authored trail of links into an accessible <nav><ol> breadcrumb, treating the last item as the current (aria-current) page. Base name recorded as 'breadcrumbs' for future variant tracking even though no vanilla template exists.
